title: Pre-NKD last-chance SPY refresh, and the Monday nobody was covering

verdicts.required_date_logic: the previous TRADING day, asked of track1_freshness rather than restated; verified across weekends and Labor Day

the_job.label: SPY_LAST_CHANCE_PRE_NKD
the_job.why_those: everything that runs before the 13:45 pre-flight reads this file and refuses if it is short

required_date.rule: the previous trading day at the ET session date
required_date.why_the_clock_matters: that helper's docstring records the measurement: on any machine west of ET the 01:10-02:55 slots land on the PREVIOUS local date; a job at 00:45 would ask for the wrong session by one day exactly when it matters most

the_gap_this_job_exists_for.why: the previous trading day is the Friday, and the last evening rung ran Friday 17:15 — thirty-one hours earlier
the_gap_this_job_exists_for.before_this_stage: nothing between Friday 17:15 and Monday 01:10 ever looked

already_covered.message: nothing to do — the daily series covers <day>, which is what the overnight window and both Calm phases will ask for.
already_covered.comparison: >= not ==; a file already ahead of the requirement is not short

recovered.message: RECOVERED at the last look — <day> arrived after the evening ladder had given up. The 17:15 rung is running before the provider is ready on at least some days.
recovered.why_not_info: a last chance that keeps saving the evening is an evening schedule that wants moving

still_missing.message: SPY daily file is missing <day>; NKD/Calm freshness-bound slots will refuse unless manually refreshed. ... This is the LAST attempt before the overnight window at 01:10 — nothing else looks until the 13:45 pre-flight, which is after both Calm phases.
still_missing.why_distinct: same shortfall, two moments: the evening rung says a morning is at risk, this one says the morning is lost unless somebody acts now

three_outcomes.dry_run: reports that nothing was attempted and returns; it does not judge itself against a file nothing touched

status_and_dashboard.why_not_needed: both compute the requirement from the same freshness module, so at 00:45 they already name the same day
status_and_dashboard.evidence: on 2026-08-27 the NKD audit read PASS on 22 of 22 slots while its per-slot diagnostics said the inputs were stale — two true facts about different things

real_mutations: the calendar replaced so the requirement becomes the session's own day
the calendar replaced so the holiday stops being skipped
source_guards: the final shortfall is still logged at ERROR
the no-op comparison has not been inverted or narrowed to equality
tests.guard_vs_mutation: the guarded branches live inside a closure that cannot be reached from outside to be broken, so they assert a property of the source. A source guard catches an edit, not a behaviour — weaker, and labelled so nobody counts four mutations here.

pin_i_broke_and_repaired.what: the previous stage's test asserted the scheduler's TOTAL size (63/133/104)
pin_i_broke_and_repaired.broken_by: this stage adding one job unrelated to the ladder
pin_i_broke_and_repaired.why_it_matters: the roster anti-pattern already on this project's record — a pin that fails for something it is not about teaches whoever reads it that the failure is noise
pin_i_broke_and_repaired.repair: expressed as a property: the ladder is the three named rungs in every mode
pin_i_broke_and_repaired.and_prospectively: this stage's own equivalent test was rewritten the same way before it could rot — the SPY family is four named jobs
